ResearchDone.criterion: One scoped research question, architecture candidates, exact contrast and reopen conditions recorded before outcomes
Task/source ancestry, license, train/dev/final-test split, neutral outcome semantics and trusted scorer qualified
Development campaign phase closed; no family leakage into confirmation; manipulation and noise/cost feasibility documented
Fixed code/prompt/action/budget/selection/invalid/retry/analysis contract and new user execution approval
All assigned campaign outcomes, failures, interventions and full resource records closed; no silent replacement or missing legs
Preselected single-artifact held-out analysis, uncertainty, diagnostics and independent numeric rederivation completed
ArchitectureSelectionRecord applies predeclared positive/null/negative/inconclusive rule; no outcome-based goalpost change
Closed source/claim/run/unit/denominator evidence snapshot with support boundaries; broader prior art residual adjudicated

valid_null_negative: Can finish a fixed, adequately scoped programme. Absence of statistical significance alone is not equivalence/noninferiority.
inconclusive: Can close a bounded study with explicit uncertainty; cannot claim success or choose a graph winner from wide intervals.
invalid_only: Close as feasibility/instrument failure, never as efficacy; obtain an explicit paper-scope decision rather than endless repairs or success relabeling.
PublicationReady_after_writing: final figure bytes with proposed/instrument/result status
PrototypeReadiness_separate: ArchitectureSelectionRecord maps generic chosen design to internal owner/ports
event rules on permitted prebuilt/reused code clarified
native construction resume gates and explicit restart satisfied
minimal end-to-end demo exercises actual candidate comparison and successor, not simulated multi-run status
not_required_to_begin_writing: finished figure pixels or final PDF metadata before manuscript exists
world-init/parity completion if not selected as task prerequisite
